summary: A task tracker with an in-memory task list.

suggestions.title: Save tasks between launches
suggestions.prompt: Persist tasks so they survive relaunch. Verify that adding and completing tasks still works after reopening the app.
suggestions.reason: Tasks currently live only in memory.

suggestions.title: Filter completed tasks
suggestions.prompt: Add a filter for open and completed tasks. Keep the filter selection when navigating away and back.
suggestions.reason: The list currently shows all tasks together.

suggestions.title: Handle an empty task list
suggestions.prompt: Add a helpful empty state with a clear action to create the first task. Check the initial state and the state after deleting the final task.
suggestions.reason: The list returns an empty array without a dedicated state.
